metadata.title: Verified international and foreign higher-education presence in Vietnam
metadata.important_note: This file deliberately separates legally established foreign-invested universities from alliance programs, delivery locations, bilateral public universities, and vocational joint programs. These categories must not be treated as equivalent legal entities.

institutions.name: RMIT University Vietnam
institutions.notes: RMIT states that it operates two campuses in Vietnam. In August 2026 it received a Foreign Branch Campus licence for Saigon South and an IRC for Hanoi.

institutions.name: British University Vietnam
institutions.notes: International university in Vietnam; University of London recognises BUV as a teaching centre delivering University of London degrees.

institutions.name: Fulbright University Vietnam
institutions.notes: The establishment decision states FUV is a 100% foreign-invested, not-for-profit higher education institution.

institutions.name: The American University in Vietnam
institutions.notes: Four-year degree granting American-model university in Vietnam.

institutions.name: Trường Đại học Y khoa Tokyo Việt Nam
institutions.english_name: Tokyo Human Health Sciences University Vietnam
institutions.notes: Project entity listed by the university: Japan Health Sciences Education (Vietnam) Co., Ltd.

institutions.name: Swinburne Vietnam
institutions.parent_or_partner: Swinburne University of Technology + FPT University
institutions.notes: Officially described as the Swinburne Vietnam Alliance Program, not an independent Vietnamese university legal entity.

institutions.name: Greenwich Vietnam
institutions.notes: University of Greenwich lists FPT University delivery locations in four Vietnamese cities.

institutions.name: Western Sydney University Vietnam
institutions.parent_or_partner: Western Sydney University + University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City (UEH)
institutions.notes: Western Sydney University officially calls Vietnam a delivery location operated in partnership with UEH.

institutions.name: Melbourne Polytechnic Vietnam
institutions.notes: International VET partnership; qualifications are awarded by Melbourne Polytechnic Australia.

institutions.name: Vietnamese-German University
institutions.notes: Vietnamese public university developed through Vietnam-Germany governmental cooperation; not foreign-owned.

institutions.name: University of Science and Technology of Hanoi
institutions.notes: Vietnam-France public university established under intergovernmental cooperation; not foreign-owned.

institutions.name: Vietnam Japan University
institutions.parent_or_partner: Vietnam National University, Hanoi + Japanese partners
institutions.notes: Member university of VNU Hanoi created from Vietnam-Japan cooperation; not foreign-owned.

institutions.name: University of London programmes at British University Vietnam
institutions.parent_or_partner: University of London + British University Vietnam
institutions.notes: BUV is officially listed by University of London as a Recognised Teaching Centre.
